title: TaleWeaver: Generative AI Roleplaying
author: Ok_Mathematician2887
selftext:
I am building TaleWeaver as an AI-driven, interactive storytelling text adventure engine. 

TaleWeaver is not just another text adventure. It is a next-generation, browser-based RPG driven entirely by an omniscient AI Gamemaster. By combining state-of-the-art Large Language Models with cinematic Text-to-Speech (TTS), TaleWeaver dynamically generates worlds, characters, and storylines on the fly, reacting to your every decision.

It's Open Source and available on GitHub.

comments.author: benawheeler
comments.body: How was the experience building it and testing? Does the story ever drift or have issues with long form coherence?

replies.author: Ok_Mathematician2887
replies.body: Thx for this great question. Testing ist definitely challenging. Especially keeping the LLM on track. To solve the bottleneck, I build an automated "play agent". This agent acts as a virtual player that constantly tries to play through the generated adventures, interacting with objects and NPCs to find dead ends, broken exists, or logic breaks. It documents findings in a local logfile. Regarding long coherences ans story drift: LLMs naturally want to hallucinate or lose the plot over long sessions. The best sollution is not to rely purely on the context window. TaleWeaver runs a strict 2-pass logic system under the hood.
